requirement: **One traceable reason for every important AI decision.**
**No optional module can take the whole app down.**
**No old code becomes authoritative merely because it already exists.**
**No external provider becomes the source of James's rules.**
**No architecture shortcut is accepted because it is faster.**
**The foundation is designed to survive years of growth, not merely the next rebuild.**
**Isolated replacement environment** — new Command Center runs independently until final acceptance.
**No incremental production Frankenstein** — unfinished replacement modules never get mixed into the old runtime simply to show progress.
**Final cutover manifest** — exact list of everything being replaced when the new system takes over.
**Atomic cutover principle** — production should switch from one coherent version to another coherent version, not spend days half-old/half-new.
**Compatibility matrix** — document which frontend, database, schema, Brain, Agent, service-worker, and module versions can safely coexist.
**System invariants document** — rules that must literally never become false, such as “one Project Auto project per run.”
**Domain invariants registry** — every core business rule is written once and enforced consistently.
**Cross-invariant conflict detection** — contradictory invariants fail validation.
**Runtime invariant assertions** for critical impossible states.
**No direct database writes that bypass state transitions.**
**No screen-specific invented status labels that alter meaning.**
